matters.title: Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Emergency Pump Repair Agreement
matters.text:
..Title
Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Emergency Pump Repair Agreement
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution ratifying the emergency agreement with Industrial Machine Shop for emergency pump repairs at the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility in an amount not to exceed $42,145, which includes a 5% contingency.

matters.title: Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Harris and Associates for the Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements, CIP 9009
matters.text:
..Title
Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Harris and Associates for the Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements, CIP 9009
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution approving Amendment No. 2 to amend and restate the Professional Services Agreement with Harris and Associates for the Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements project to increase the schedule of the agreement and to increase the total compensation by $29,720 for a total compensation of $393,538.

matters.title: Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements at Airport Blvd. Project, CIP 9009 - Bid Rejection
matters.text:
..Title
Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements at Airport Blvd. Project, CIP 9009 - Bid Rejection
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution rejecting all bids for the Industrial Wastewater Pump Station Improvements at Airport Blvd., CIP 9009.

matters.title: Agreement with Industrial Machine Shop for Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Emergency Pump 2 Repair
matters.text:
..Title
Agreement with Industrial Machine Shop for Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Emergency Pump 2 Repair
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution ratifying the emergency agreement with Industrial Machine Shop for emergency pump repairs at the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility in an amount not to exceed $38,243.93, with a 5% contingency for unforeseen repairs.

matters.title: Conditional Use Permit 2024-022;  Request to establish and operate a proposed Off-sale Alcohol Related use (Type 20 ABC license) in a proposed Convenience Store with Gas Pumps located at 1012 and 1016 Abbott Street in the IGC (Industrial-General Commercial) Zoning District.
matters.text:
..Title
Conditional Use Permit 2024-022;  Request to establish and operate a proposed Off-sale Alcohol Related use (Type 20 ABC license) in a proposed Convenience Store with Gas Pumps located at 1012 and 1016 Abbott Street in the IGC (Industrial-General Commercial) Zoning District.
..Recommended Action
Approve a resolution finding the project exempt pursuant to Sections 15061(b)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines, affirming the findings, and approving Conditional Use Permit 2024-022.

matters.title: Pump, Motor, and Mechanical Repair Services Award for the City’s Sewer Pump Stations
matters.text:
..Title
Pump, Motor, and Mechanical Repair Services Award for the City's Sewer Pump Stations
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution awarding contracts to Fluid Resource Management, Inc. and Koffler Electrical Mechanical Apparatus Repair, Inc. for Pump, Motor, and Mechanical Repair Services for two years beginning on the date of execution with an option to extend the term for two (2) additional years in amount not to exceed amount of $1,000,000; and authorizing the City Manager to execute the agreements and extensions and/or modifications to the Pump, Motor, and Mechanical Repair Services Contract and to take whatever additional action may be necessary to effectuate the intent of this resolution.

matters.title: Rejection of Bids for the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Influent Pump Station and Electrical Improvements, CIP 9317
matters.text:
..Title
Rejection of Bids for the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Influent Pump Station and Electrical Improvements, CIP 9317
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution rejecting all bids for the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Facility Influent Pump Station and Electrical Improvements, CIP 9317.

matters.title: Energy Services Contract with ENGIE for Photovolatic (PV) Systems and Back-Up Generator at City Facilities
matters.text:
..Title
Energy Services Contract with ENGIE for Photovolatic (PV) Systems and Back-Up Generator at City Facilities

..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution finding that the energy conservation project (the "Project") proposed by ENGIE Services U.S. is exempt from requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); and approving an energy conservation services agreement with ENGIE Services U.S.

matters.title: CIP Budget Reallocation for Lake Street Lift Station Pump 1 - Replacement/Upgrades
matters.text:
..Title
CIP Budget Reallocation for Lake Street Lift Station Pump 1 - Replacement/Upgrades
..Recommended Action
Approve a Resolution approving the reallocation of $375,730 from CIP 9010 (CCTV Inspections) to CIP 9222 (E Lake St Pump Station upgrades).
